## Services Offered

1. **Web Development:** Modern, high-performance web applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
2. **Mobile App Development:** Native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps crafted with Flutter and React Native.
3. **AI Solutions & Integrations:** Custom LLM workflows, conversational AI assistants, LangChain agents, vector database search, and automated intelligence.
4. **API & Backend Engineering:** Resilient microservices, REST APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and real-time WebSocket infrastructure.
5. **Cloud & DevOps:** Docker containerization, AWS/GCP architecture, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines, and Cloudflare edge performance.
6. **UI/UX Design:** User-centric wireframes, design systems, and responsive interactive prototypes in Figma.
7. **E-Commerce Solutions:** Scalable multi-tenant e-commerce platforms, payment gateway integrations (Stripe, bKash, Nagad), and cart/order management.
8. **Freelance Consulting:** Architecture audits, performance tuning, code refactoring, and technical advisory for startups.

## Featured Projects

### 1. Foundation Management
- **Description:** Non-profit foundation management platform empowering underprivileged communities through education, youth leadership, verified volunteer tracking, and transparent digital donations.
- **Tech Stack:** Laravel, PHP, React, Inertia.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare, REST API
- **Repository:** https://github.com/theshoaibme/ihaveaplanfoundation
- **Live Preview:** https://ihaveaplanfoundation.com/

### 2. Doctor Portfolio
- **Description:** Production healthcare platform for Dr. Ab Rahman Miah: public marketing website plus a full admin portal for appointments, chamber management, patient records, CMS content, live chat, and clinic operations.
- **Tech Stack:** Laravel 12, PHP 8.2/8.3, React, Inertia.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Laravel Reverb, Laravel Horizon, FrankenPHP / Octane, Docker, Bun, Google SSO / WebAuthn / 2FA
- **Repository:** https://github.com/theshoaibme/orthopedicsurgeon
- **Live Preview:** https://orthopedicsurgeonrahman.com/

### 3. DeepConnect Provider
- **Description:** OAuth 2.0 integration middleware & multi-platform API provider connecting web applications with Google Workspace, Meta APIs, Slack, and webhooks with AES-256 token encryption.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, OAuth 2.0, REST API, Vercel
- **Repository:** https://github.com/the-shoaib2/deepconnect
- **Live Preview:** https://deepconnect.theshoaib.me/

### 4. Kivorly
- **Description:** All-in-one on-demand super app for Bangladesh — ride-sharing, food delivery, grocery bazaar, ticket booking, parcel courier, and fashion shopping across 64 districts with bKash and Nagad payments.
- **Tech Stack:** SwiftUI, iOS, Jetpack Compose, Android, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js
- **Repository:** https://github.com/theshoaibme/kivorly

### 5. Meal Sphere
- **Description:** Collaborative meal planning and recipe sharing community platform with smart nutritional calculations.
- **Tech Stack:** React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Prisma, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form, NextAuth.js, Dotenv, Framer Motion, Recharts, Lucide React, Nodemailer
- **Repository:** https://github.com/theshoaibme/meal-sphere
- **Live Preview:** https://meal-sphere.vercel.app

### 6. SobujBD
- **Description:** AI-powered smart agriculture and eco-monitoring platform with computer vision plant disease detection, geo-spatial mapping, and multi-tenant farm management.
- **Tech Stack:** React, Vite, Spring Boot, FastAPI, PostGIS, Redis, MinIO, YOLOv8, Tesseract, Docker, Turborepo
- **Repository:** https://github.com/zionmezba/sobujbd
- **Live Preview:** https://app3.csetech.diu.edu.bd/

### 8. App Pro
- **Description:** High-performance native Linux desktop application and utility suite written in Rust with modern GTK4 bindings.
- **Tech Stack:** Rust, GTK4, Linux, Cargo
- **Repository:** https://github.com/theshoaibme/app-pro

### 9. Pregnify
- **Description:** AI-powered pregnancy health monitoring platform for real-time risk assessment, vitals tracking, and emergency physician alerts.
- **Tech Stack:** Node.js, Express.js, Prisma, MySQL, JWT, OpenAI, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Chart.js
- **Repository:** https://github.com/theshoaibme/Pregnify

### 10. Supershop Management System
- **Description:** Enterprise retail management platform featuring point-of-sale (POS), barcode generation, real-time inventory tracking, and sales analytics.
- **Tech Stack:** Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Kafka, JWT, Cloudinary, OpenAPI, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Framer Motion, React Router, React Query, Zustand, Recharts
- **Repository:** https://github.com/theshoaibme/Super-Shop-Management
